}}{{TIDTOC|adapter}} ==Overview== ===Product Key Features=== *[[Qualcomm Atheros]] ''’‘Cascade’’'' QCA9984 *Mini PCIe interface with PCIe 2.0, JTAG/UART connector *5GHz max 21dBm output power (per chain), FCC/CE certified, REACH & RoHS Compliance *802.11ac compliant & backward compatible with 802.11a/n (1.73Gbps) *2x spatial streams (2SS) MIMO 160/80+80 MHz bandwidth support *4x spatial streams (4SS) Multi-user MIMO (MU-MIMO) *802.11ac explicit transmit beamforming (TxBF) and legacy implicit :TxBF for both beamformer and beamformee *Supports Spatial Multiplexing, Maximal Ratio Combining (MRC), :Cyclic-Delay Diversity (CDD), Space Time Block Code (STBC), :Low-Density Parity Check (LDPC) Codes *Supports Dynamic Frequency Selection (DFS) *Supports IEEE 802.11d,e,h,i,j,k,r,u,v time stamp, w and z standards *Designed for High Bandwidth Enterprise Wireless Access Points
